notes.title: Holiday controller patch
notes.notes:
Hello this is BATTLE X.

Holiday controller patch is finally here!

This patch addresses some inconvenience issue of using VR controllers.

Thanks to all the players who love BATTLE X and sent us feedback, we’ve taken one step closer to you.

Please check out on the updates in the Tutorial of the game before play.

Enjoy, and kindly let us know your thoughts.

Hope to see you guys more often in BATTLE X.

Happy holidays!

notes.title: Integration with bHaptics!
notes.notes:
Hello This is BATTLE X.
 
Today, we're going to tell you some interesting news.
It is about an integration with bHaptics!
Please set up bHapticsPlayer on your PC where BATTLE X is installed, then you can enjoy more realistic play.
 
Thank you.

notes.title: BATTLE X Server consolidation
notes.notes:
Hello. This is BATTLE X.

It's been almost a week since BATTLE X was launched officially. 
Thank you for your interest and support that you've shown to us so far.

We are very carefully listening to your precious words, and considering it to the future updates. 

Today, we are here to announce our server consolidation. 
As you might know well, the charm of BATTLE X is multi-play, so for more enjoyable and thrilled multi-play with more players, we've started to operate the servers in two regions, one is for Europe / America and the other is in Asia. 

Please select the server that has more green color, which means that server is closer to your location. 

Thank you and looking forward to playing with you in BATTLE X!
